event_chain.summary: Employee data disclosed to an unauthorized recipient

summary: On or around May 19, 2026 staffing and recruiting firm Cross Resource Group (formerly Cross Recruiting Inc.) discovered that one of its employees had inadvertently disclosed personal information of current and former employees to an unauthorized recipient. The data included names, addresses, Social Security numbers, dates of birth, payroll and tax information and government ID numbers of 301 people. The company notified them and Massachusetts and New Hampshire regulators from June 26 and offered 24 months of credit monitoring.
